sloka: प्रहृष्टा मुदिता लंका मत्त द्विप समाकुला ।महती रथ सम्पूर्णा रक्षो गण समाकुला ॥६-३-१०॥।।
transliteration: prahṛṣṭā muditā laṁkā matta dvipa samākulā ।mahatī ratha sampūrṇā rakṣo gaṇa samākulā ॥6-3-10॥।।

translations.english: "The people in the vast island of Lanka are very delighted. Lanka is filled with chariots and innumerable rakshasas."
